description: M.A. Kiribanda v. I.M. Ariyaratne, Grama Niladhari of Hangamuwa and Another M.A. Kiribanda v. I.M. Ariyaratne, Grama Niladhari of Hangamuwa and Another View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: M.A. Kiribanda v. I.M. Ariyaratne, Grama Niladhari of Hangamuwa and Another M.A. Kiribanda v. I.M. Ariyaratne, Grama Niladhari of Hangamuwa and Another View More
keywords: The Appellant sought damages from the 1st Respondent and also named the Attorney General as a defendant, though no relief was claimed against him. The District Court struck out the Attorney General as improperly joined in terms of Section 18(1) and 14 of the Civil Procedure Code; Appellant challenged the same in this Application. Held - the plaint lacked any basis for liability against the Attorney General; therefore, Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
